failures.injected_rule: When defining a module's interface, ensure that the functional statefulness (state persistence across calls) and shape semantics (dimensionality of inputs vs outputs) are modeled via explicit class structures or unambiguous scalar/1D return contracts respectively, because hidden instance state in pure functions leads to silent contract failures and ambiguous shapes break downstream consumer expectations.

rules.rule: When designing module interfaces for metrics that depend on raw scores versus binary predictions, explicitly define a deterministic thresholding or scoring conversion step within the experiment module's contract, because undefined transitions from continuous outputs to discrete labels introduce ambiguity in metric calculation.

When defining a module's interface, ensure that the functional statefulness (state persistence across calls) and shape semantics (dimensionality of inputs vs outputs) are modeled via explicit class structures or unambiguous scalar/1D return contracts respectively, because hidden instance state in pure functions leads to silent contract failures and ambiguous shapes break downstream consumer expectations.
